description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, providing REST API endpoints for managing employee membership records, including CRUD operations, validation, and related business logic.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPI
classes.description: Provides REST API endpoints for managing employee memberships, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee membership records.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and retrieves the EmployeeMembershipService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific employee membership by ID and employee number.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a list of employee memberships for a specific employee.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new employee membership record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing employee membership record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or more employee memberships.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Constructs and persists an EmployeeMembership entity based on request parameters, handling both creation and update scenarios.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the delete method.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for the request body when creating or updating an employee membership.
